preconditions.description: Number of testcases T is between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(A) == len(B) <= 10**5 for A, B in zip(testcases_A, testcases_B))
preconditions.description: Length of A and B for each testcase is between 1 and 100,000 and they are equal.

postconditions.description: The number of lines in the output is equal to the number of testcases T.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, int) for line in output)
postconditions.description: Each line in the output is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= count <= len(A) for count in output)
postconditions.description: Each count in the output is between 0 and the length of A.
